Package jDisco

Interface Summary
Condition This interface is used in combination with the waitUntil-method for specifying state-events.
 

Class Summary
Accumulate This class can be used for collecting time dependent data, e.g.
Continuous This class may be used to describe the continuous processes of a model.
Coroutine This class may be used for coroutine sequencing in Java.
ExpDelay This class may be used to describe exponential delays of arbitrary order.
Format  
Function The solution of higher-order differential equations normally requires that the user rewrites the system as first-order equations.
Graph This class facilitates curve plotting.
Head This class is used for representing circular two-way lists.
Histogram This class can be used for collecting time independent data and for producing a graphical representation of the collected data.
IDelay This class may be used to describe ideal delays.

The state of an active IDelay-object lags behind a given target's state with a specified delay, lag.

The target may itself be moving.

During the first lag time units of an IDelay-object's existence its state is equal to target's state at the creation of the IDelay-object.

An IDelay-object stores samples of target's state at the end of each integration step and interpolates linearly between sampled values.
Implicit In describing continuous processes it is the user's responsibility that the equations are evaluated in the correct order: variables must be updated before they are used on the right-hand side of an equation.
Link This class is used for representing items in a circular two-way list.
Linkage This class is used for representing the linkages of a circular two-way list.
PDEVariable This class may used for the description of state-variables that vary according to partial differential equations.
PDEVariable.Point Each Point-object represents one of the points of a PDEVariable, (x, state()).
Process This class may be used to describe the processes of a model.
Random A class for random drawing.
Reporter This class may be used for reporting purposes.
Tab This class defines the common core of the data colllection classes Accumulate, Count, Histogram and Tally.
Table This class facilitates table-lookup.
Tally This class can be used for collecting time independent data, e.g.
Variable This class is used to represent state variables that vary between discrete events according to ordinary first-order differential equations and/or difference equations.
 

Exception Summary
DiscoException jDisco throws this runtime exception whenever it detects an error.
